name: By My Side
source:
Ash Lee just wants to survive high school. The thoughts of the future after graduation scare him. His parents never understand him. His crush doesn’t even try to get to know him.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
阿什·李只想读完高中。一想到毕业后的未来，他就感到害怕。他的父母从来不理解他。他的暗恋对象甚至没有尝试去了解他。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
